scientific_role: define a response-independent annual survey-support surface before any species detection, nondetection, occupancy, source-loss event or t2 outcome is opened

official_sampling_event_source.access_semantics: official eBird Basic Dataset data-request workflow

island_geometry.coordinate_reference: transform geometry to EPSG:4326 before checklist mapping
island_geometry.zero_polygon_matches: exclude checklist and count as outside_geometry
island_geometry.multiple_polygon_matches: exclude checklist and count as ambiguous_geometry
island_geometry.dryad_crosswalk: future Dryad ISLAND_ID is interpreted only as the corresponding Sayre OBJECTID after this geometry rule is frozen

checklist_deduplication.eligible_first: annual survey support uses only ALL SPECIES REPORTED=TRUE rows
checklist_deduplication.event_key: nonblank GROUP IDENTIFIER defines one shared sampling event; blank GROUP IDENTIFIER uses SAMPLING EVENT IDENTIFIER
checklist_deduplication.shared_group_count: a repeated nonblank GROUP IDENTIFIER contributes at most one event
checklist_deduplication.conflicting_group_coordinates: exclude group if latitude or longitude differs by more than 1e-6 degrees

annual_survey_quality_rule.rationale: response-independent support proxy anchored to published eBird completeness work: very small checklist samples are unreliable and multi-month temporal support is required; this is not the published species-accumulation completeness estimator
annual_survey_quality_rule.reason_no_effort_cutoffs: retain valid effort fields for later reference adjustment rather than select hard thresholds before the SED support surface exists

next_gate: after v1.154 and v1.155 succeed on identical SED bytes, freeze eligible islands, deterministic three-wave windows and disjoint burned-pilot/confirmatory partitions using survey support only
anti_selection: do not lower the 10-checklist or 4-month minima after species outcomes are opened
do not select years from source-loss or persistence effects
do not infer absences from Dryad observed-species rows before the survey surface is frozen
do not assign offshore points to the nearest island
do not inspect species identity to resolve ambiguous geometry
do not choose thresholds to compensate for BALA non-support
